name: Gun Runner (Yakuza Archetype)
body:
Focusing less on the weapons of their trade, an ironheart brawler ninja hones their body into a perfect weapon.

For some yakuza, the talents learned from their gang are less important than their weapons, especially when wielding black powder weapons.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A gun runner is proficient with all firearms (except siege weapons).

Gunsmithing

At 1st level, a gun runner gains Gunsmithing as a bonus feat. This replaces contacts.

Ki Shot (Su)

At 2nd level, a gun runner gains Amateur Gunslinger as a bonus feat, and they can expend points from their ki as if they were grit points. As long as a gun runner has at least 1 point in their ki, they gain a bonus on damage rolls with firearms equal to their Dexterity modifier; this bonus cannot exceed their yakuza level. This ability replaces sneak attack.

Speed Loader (Ex)

At 2nd level, a gun runner reduces the action needed to reload a firearm by 1 step (this stacks with the Rapid Reload feat). This ability replaces the gang ability gained at 2nd level.

Ki Powder (Su)

At 8th level, a gun runner can spend 1 point from their ki to double the first range increment of a firearm they wield for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

This ability replaces the gang ability gained at 8th level.

Ki Sniper (Su)

At 15th level, whenever a gun runner spends ki to increase the range increment of a firearm, that firearm also deals additional damage equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum 1) until the beginning of their next turn. This ability replaces the gang ability gained at 15th level.
